0.en: Paul's crew brought the trough into the yard behind the station a little before eleven, on the back of a flatbed, with four men walking beside it to keep it from sliding off.
0.id: Kru Paul membawa talang itu ke halaman di belakang stasiun sedikit sebelum pukul sebelas, di atas sebuah truk pengangkut, dengan empat orang berjalan di sampingnya supaya talang itu tidak tergelincir jatuh.

1.en: It wasn't a gutter anymore. It was a long, low box of corrugated roofing sheet, riveted at every seam, standing on short steel feet. It was as wide as a door and came up to Jack's knee. Along one long side, a splash board rose higher than Jack's head. The lid lay folded in three hinged sections along the front edge.
1.id: Benda itu bukan talang air lagi. Itu bak panjang dan rendah dari lembaran atap bergelombang, dikeling di setiap sambungan, berdiri di atas kaki-kaki baja yang pendek. Lebarnya selebar pintu dan tingginya sampai lutut Jack. Di sepanjang salah satu sisi panjangnya, papan penahan cipratan menjulang lebih tinggi dari kepala Jack. Tutupnya terlipat dalam tiga bagian berengsel di sepanjang tepi depan.

2.en: Mark walked all the way around it once without saying anything. Then he knocked on the side with his knuckles.
2.id: Mark berjalan mengelilinginya sekali tanpa berkata apa-apa. Lalu ia mengetuk sisinya dengan buku jari.

4.en: Paul climbed down from the flatbed, wiped his hands on a rag, and nodded at Jack.
4.id: Paul turun dari truk, mengelap tangannya dengan lap, dan mengangguk ke arah Jack.

5.en: He says the drop's as wide as a bench. This holds a few of those, if you're ever lucky enough to get a few. Which you won't be.
5.id: Katanya tetesannya selebar meja kerja. Ini bisa menampung beberapa, kalau kalian cukup beruntung bisa dapat beberapa. Dan kalian tidak bakal seberuntung itu.

6.en: He took Jack's pole off the truck and held it up. The yellow sponge was gone. In its place was a short padded fork, wrapped in rubber. A hand's width below it, a stiff rubber cup was clamped around the pole, open end down.
6.id: Ia mengambil tiang Jack dari truk dan mengangkatnya. Spons kuning itu sudah tidak ada. Sebagai gantinya ada garpu pendek berbantalan, dibungkus karet. Selebar telapak tangan di bawahnya, sebuah mangkuk karet yang kaku dijepit melingkari tiang, dengan sisi terbukanya menghadap ke bawah.

7.en: That's your collar. Water comes down the pole, it hits that, and it drips off there instead of running into your glove. The fork goes under the leaf. You lift, you let go. One shake.
7.id: Itu kerah Anda. Air turun lewat tiang, menabrak itu, lalu menetes dari situ, bukannya mengalir ke sarung tangan Anda. Garpunya masuk ke bawah daun. Angkat, lepaskan. Satu goyangan.

8.en: Lena came out of the station with a clipboard and looked the trough over.
8.id: Lena keluar dari stasiun membawa papan klip dan mengamati talang itu.

9.en: What are we testing it with?

10.en: Paul jerked his head at a blue plastic drum on the flatbed.
10.id: Paul menyentakkan kepala ke arah drum plastik biru di atas truk.

11.en: Treated water. From the holding tank. Same as the greenhouse gets. You're not spending one drop of the good stuff on a drill.
11.id: Air olahan. Dari tangki penampung. Sama dengan yang didapat rumah kaca. Kalian tidak akan menghabiskan setetes pun air yang bagus untuk latihan.

12.en: They hauled the drum up the steel stairs to the station's loading platform. Jack judged the height with his eye. Three meters, near enough. About where the big drop had hung over the end of the road.
12.id: Mereka mengangkut drum itu menaiki tangga baja ke peron bongkar muat stasiun. Jack menaksir tingginya dengan mata. Tiga meter, kurang lebih. Kira-kira setinggi tetesan besar itu menggantung di atas ujung jalan.

13.en: Mark pointed at the gravel below.

14.en: Trough goes where the drop would land. Right under.
14.id: Talang ditaruh di tempat tetesannya bakal mendarat. Tepat di bawah.

15.en: Paul and Unit Four set it there, the splash board on the platform side, the way Paul had built it to stand against the grass.
15.id: Paul dan Unit Empat menaruhnya di sana, papan penahan cipratan di sisi peron, seperti rancangan Paul untuk berdiri menghadap rumput.

18.en: Two of Paul's men tipped the drum over the edge of the platform. A long column of water came down, slapped onto the far edge of the trough, and didn't splash. It slammed down and spread, and half of it climbed the far lip like something alive and came over the side in a clear sheet. It went straight across the gravel and over Mark's boots, up to his shins, and clung there.
18.id: Dua anak buah Paul memiringkan drum itu melewati tepi peron. Kolom air yang panjang meluncur turun, menampar tepi jauh talang, dan tidak memercik. Air itu menghantam lalu menyebar, dan separuhnya memanjat bibir jauh talang seperti makhluk hidup dan melimpah lewat sisinya dalam lapisan bening. Air itu langsung melintasi kerikil dan menimpa sepatu bot Mark, sampai ke tulang keringnya, dan menempel di sana.

21.en: Unit Four made a sound that he turned into a cough.
21.id: Unit Empat mengeluarkan suara yang ia ubah menjadi batuk.

22.en: Jack was already looking at where the water had hit.
22.id: Jack sudah memandangi tempat air itu menghantam.

23.en: It didn't land under the platform. It landed out from it. It fell, and it kept moving forward.
23.id: Airnya tidak mendarat di bawah peron. Airnya mendarat menjauh dari situ. Airnya jatuh, dan terus bergerak maju.

25.en: Then my board's on the wrong side. It wants to be where the water's going, not where it's coming from.
25.id: Kalau begitu papan saya ada di sisi yang salah. Papan itu harus ada di arah tujuan airnya, bukan di arah asalnya.

26.en: A drum gets thrown. A leaf might throw it too, when it springs back. We won't know which way until we're there.
26.id: Air dari drum itu terlempar. Daun mungkin juga melemparnya, waktu memantul balik. Kita tidak akan tahu ke arah mana sampai kita di sana.

27.en: Mark was still looking at his boots.

28.en: Then the board goes on our side. Between the drop and the people. Whatever happens, it's in the way.
28.id: Kalau begitu papannya di sisi kita. Di antara tetesan dan orang-orang. Apa pun yang terjadi, papan itu menghalangi.

29.en: They turned the trough around. Paul's men refilled the drum from the holding-tank line and hauled it up again.
29.id: Mereka memutar talang itu. Anak buah Paul mengisi ulang drum dari saluran tangki penampung dan mengangkutnya naik lagi.

30.en: The second time, the water hit the splash board with a hollow boom, sheeted down it, and dropped into the trough. It rolled from one end to the other and back, slopping at the lips, and stayed in.
30.id: Kali kedua, air menghantam papan penahan cipratan dengan dentum hampa, meluncur turun di permukaannya, dan jatuh ke dalam talang. Air itu bergulung dari satu ujung ke ujung lain dan kembali, berkecipak di bibirnya, dan tetap di dalam.

31.en: Lena wrote something on the clipboard.
31.id: Lena menulis sesuatu di papan klip.

33.en: Paul crouched and looked along the waterline.
33.id: Paul berjongkok dan memandang sepanjang garis air.

34.en: A fifth of one of your drops, maybe. Still more than a week of mornings with that sponge.
34.id: Seperlima dari satu tetesan kalian, mungkin. Masih lebih banyak daripada seminggu penuh pagi pakai spons itu.

37.en: Unit Four took hold of the first lid section and swung it over. It went down onto the water, and the water rose up to meet it, the way it had climbed Jack's pole. When he went to lift it back to check, it didn't want to come. He pulled harder, and the lid came up all at once, dragging a heavy sheet of water up with it that hung from the underside and then dropped across his arms.
37.id: Unit Empat memegang bagian tutup yang pertama dan mengayunkannya menutup. Tutup itu turun ke atas air, dan air naik menyambutnya, seperti cara air memanjat tiang Jack. Ketika ia hendak mengangkatnya kembali untuk memeriksa, tutup itu tidak mau terangkat. Ia menarik lebih keras, dan tutup itu terangkat sekaligus, menyeret selapis air yang berat, yang menggantung di bagian bawahnya lalu jatuh menimpa lengannya.

38.en: Unit Four didn't flinch. He held the lid where it was until the water had finished running off it.
38.id: Unit Empat tidak berjengit. Ia menahan tutup itu di tempatnya sampai air selesai mengalir darinya.

39.en: Paul was already pulling a roll of rubber strip out of his pocket.
39.id: Paul sudah mengeluarkan segulung strip karet dari sakunya.

40.en: Not your fault. It sticks. Water at our size grabs anything flat. I'll run this along the edges, so it sits on the rim, not the water. And you close it slow. Like Aiden said about cups. Never lift it fast, never lift it at all out there. You close it, and you leave it closed.
40.id: Bukan salahmu. Tutupnya lengket. Di ukuran kita, air mencengkeram apa saja yang rata. Saya pasang ini di sepanjang tepinya, supaya tutupnya bertumpu di bibir, bukan di air. Dan menutupnya pelan-pelan. Seperti kata Aiden soal gelas. Jangan pernah diangkat cepat, jangan pernah diangkat sama sekali di luar sana. Tutup, lalu biarkan tertutup.

41.en: Jack's wrist buzzed. Aiden's voice came through, tired and careful.
41.id: Pergelangan Jack bergetar. Suara Aiden terdengar, lelah dan hati-hati.

42.en: Doctor Bennett, the long test's done.
42.id: Dokter Bennett, uji jangka panjangnya sudah selesai.

43.en: Jack stepped away from the noise.

45.en: There's something living in it. Not much. Not anything I'd lose sleep over. The kind of thing that's in every pond, at a very low level. Nothing boiling won't kill.
45.id: Ada sesuatu yang hidup di dalamnya. Tidak banyak. Bukan yang bikin aku susah tidur. Jenis yang ada di setiap kolam, dalam kadar sangat rendah. Tidak ada yang tidak mati kalau direbus.

46.en: Jack thought of Aiden drinking the first cup, flat and tasting of nothing.
46.id: Jack teringat Aiden meminum cangkir pertama, hambar dan tak berasa apa-apa.

47.en: And the cup you drank yesterday?
47.id: Lalu cangkir yang kamu minum kemarin?

48.en: Was boiled. I'm fine. But that's the rule now. Boil it. Always. And whatever stands out there with water in it gets covered. It's not only things falling in. It's things growing in it.
48.id: Sudah direbus. Aku baik-baik saja. Tapi itu aturannya sekarang. Rebus. Selalu. Dan apa pun yang ada di luar sana dan berisi air harus ditutup. Bukan cuma soal benda yang jatuh ke dalamnya. Tapi juga yang tumbuh di dalamnya.

49.en: Jack relayed it. Mark wrote Boil it, always on the side of the trough with a grease pencil, in letters a hand high, so nobody could miss it.
49.id: Jack meneruskannya. Mark menulis Rebus, selalu di sisi talang dengan pensil lilin, dengan huruf setinggi telapak tangan, supaya tak ada yang bisa melewatkannya.

50.en: Paul ran his rubber strip along the first edge while Lena held the lid steady. He didn't look up.
50.id: Paul memasang strip karetnya di sepanjang tepi pertama sementara Lena menahan tutupnya. Ia tidak mendongak.

51.en: Your security people. Anything yet on who did it?
51.id: Orang-orang keamanan Anda. Sudah ada kabar siapa pelakunya?

52.en: Jack glanced at Mark. Mark was looking at the trough. Jack answered for both of them.
52.id: Jack melirik Mark. Mark sedang memandangi talang. Jack menjawab untuk mereka berdua.

54.en: Paul pressed the strip down along the rim with his thumb, the whole length of it.
54.id: Paul menekan strip itu di sepanjang bibir talang dengan ibu jarinya, dari ujung ke ujung.

56.en: In the afternoon, Mark wheeled his whiteboard out of the station and stood it on the gravel next to the trough. Under Cold, Clear, Gray, Covered, he wrote the numbers, one line at a time, and read them out as he wrote.
56.id: Sore harinya, Mark mendorong papan tulisnya keluar dari stasiun dan menegakkannya di atas kerikil di samping talang. Di bawah Dingin, Cerah, Kelabu, Tertutup, ia menulis angka-angkanya, satu baris demi satu baris, dan membacakannya sambil menulis.

57.en: Clear sky at first gray. Stars. Not a cloud. Door thermometer at eight degrees Celsius or under, when we get there. Aiden reads it, nobody else. Trough goes out in the dark, under the red lamp, board on our side. One leaf. One lift. One drop. Lid shut, slow. Everybody back off the edge at first sun, or at ten degrees on that door, whichever comes first. I don't care what's still hanging.
57.id: Langit cerah saat kelabu pertama. Ada bintang. Tidak ada awan sama sekali. Termometer pintu di delapan derajat Celsius atau kurang, waktu kita sampai. Aiden yang membacanya, bukan orang lain. Talang dibawa keluar dalam gelap, di bawah lampu merah, papan di sisi kita. Satu daun. Satu kali angkat. Satu tetesan. Tutup dirapatkan, pelan. Semua orang mundur dari tepian begitu sinar matahari pertama datang, atau begitu termometer pintu itu menunjukkan sepuluh derajat, mana yang lebih dulu. Aku tidak peduli apa yang masih menggantung.

59.en: This isn't a water supply. It's a test. If it works, we've learned one thing. If it doesn't, we've learned another.
59.id: Ini bukan pasokan air. Ini uji coba. Kalau berhasil, kita belajar satu hal. Kalau tidak, kita belajar hal lain.

60.en: Jack read the list twice. It was good. It was better than good. It was the plan he would have made if he hadn't wanted the water so badly.
60.id: Jack membaca daftar itu dua kali. Daftar itu bagus. Lebih dari bagus. Itu rencana yang akan ia buat sendiri seandainya ia tidak begitu menginginkan air itu.

62.en: Doctor Mercer came to the house at eight. Sarah had her notebook open on her knee again, three pages fuller than the night before. Doctor Mercer wrapped the cuff around her arm and watched the numbers come up.
62.id: Dokter Mercer datang ke rumah pukul delapan. Buku catatan Sarah terbuka lagi di lututnya, tiga halaman lebih penuh daripada malam sebelumnya. Dokter Mercer melilitkan manset di lengan Sarah dan memperhatikan angka-angkanya muncul.

63.en: Then she watched them a second time.

66.id: Lebih baik dalam arti lebih baik?

67.en: Better as in a little. Better as in I'll take it. Don't celebrate.
67.id: Lebih baik dalam arti sedikit. Lebih baik dalam arti saya terima. Jangan dirayakan.

68.en: I wasn't going to celebrate. I was going to write it down.
68.id: Saya tidak mau merayakan. Saya mau mencatatnya.

69.en: Doctor Mercer turned to Jack. She peeled back the corner of his dressing, looked at the stitches, and pressed the tape back down.
69.id: Dokter Mercer berbalik ke Jack. Ia mengelupas sudut perbannya, melihat jahitannya, lalu menekan plesternya kembali.

71.en: On her way to the door she stopped by the corner, where the crib stood with both ends and one rail on, leaning slightly to the left. She looked at it for a while.
71.id: Dalam perjalanan ke pintu ia berhenti di dekat sudut, tempat boks bayi berdiri dengan kedua ujung dan satu pagar terpasang, sedikit miring ke kiri. Ia memandanginya beberapa saat.

75.en: It shows. If you're on that pole in the morning, wear the glove and the bag. Take them off the second you're back in the truck.
75.id: Kelihatan. Kalau Anda memegang tiang itu besok pagi, pakai sarung tangan dan kantongnya. Lepaskan begitu Anda kembali di truk.

76.en: At half past ten, Lena's voice came over Jack's wrist.
76.id: Pukul setengah sebelas, suara Lena terdengar di pergelangan Jack.

77.en: Aiden's at the greenhouse. The clouds have gone. He can see stars from the door. Thermometer says seven degrees, and it's falling.
77.id: Aiden di rumah kaca. Awannya sudah hilang. Dia bisa melihat bintang dari pintu. Termometer menunjukkan tujuh derajat, dan terus turun.

78.en: Mark's voice came in a moment later, on the same channel. He must have been listening. He was quiet for a while.
78.id: Suara Mark masuk sesaat kemudian, di kanal yang sama. Ia pasti sedang mendengarkan. Ia diam beberapa lama.

79.en: Then we test it. First gray. One shake. Paul, load it.
79.id: Kalau begitu kita uji. Kelabu pertama. Satu goyangan. Paul, muat.

80.en: Paul's voice was thick with sleep.

81.en: Already on the truck. I had a feeling.
81.id: Sudah di truk. Saya sudah punya firasat.

83.en: Jack set the alarm on his wrist for a quarter past four, and checked it, and set it again. Then he sat down on the couch next to Sarah. She had the notebook closed now, her hands folded over it, and she was looking at him.
83.id: Jack menyetel alarm di pergelangannya untuk pukul empat lewat seperempat, memeriksanya, lalu menyetelnya lagi. Lalu ia duduk di sofa di samping Sarah. Buku catatannya sudah tertutup sekarang, kedua tangannya terlipat di atasnya, dan ia sedang memandang Jack.

87.en: You did it to me last time. Now it's my turn. If your number goes up while I'm out there?
87.id: Terakhir kali kamu melakukannya padaku. Sekarang giliranku. Kalau angkamu naik selagi aku di luar sana?

91.en: And if you feel a headache? Or your eyes go strange?
91.id: Dan kalau kamu sakit kepala? Atau penglihatanmu jadi aneh?

93.en: And if you see something on the cameras that I need to know?
93.id: Dan kalau kamu melihat sesuatu di kamera yang perlu kuketahui?

95.en: Then I call Mark. Because you'll be busy holding a pole, and you shouldn't be looking at your wrist.
95.id: Kalau begitu aku telepon Mark. Karena kamu bakal sibuk memegang tiang, dan kamu tidak boleh melihat pergelanganmu.

96.en: Jack thought about arguing with that, and found he couldn't.
96.id: Jack berpikir untuk membantahnya, dan ternyata tidak bisa.

97.en: She leaned against his shoulder, and he put his good arm around her, and outside, past the rooftops, the stars were out over the grass, cold and clear, exactly the way they wanted them.
97.id: Sarah bersandar di bahunya, dan Jack merangkulnya dengan lengannya yang sehat, dan di luar, di balik atap-atap, bintang-bintang bersinar di atas rumput, dingin dan cerah, persis seperti yang mereka inginkan.
